{{DesktopLinux}}

This cheatsheet recommends handy FOSS for common use cases on desktop Linux.

Some quick caveats:

* Most FOSS recommended here work across popular Linux distributions. With the sheer number of Linux distributions out there, there is however no guarantee they will work on all distributions.
* There is no pretention made that software listed here are the best in their category. The charm of FOSS ecosystem is new, better software is being made every second, as you are reading this line.
